features.note: Extreme aspect ratio reads unmistakably as a 0U vertical bar — not a fat box or horizontal chassis. Both strips display correct ~33:1 slender form standing on the long axis. Silhouette is the strongest element of this blockout.

feeda shot: continuous column of light-grey housing elements runs the outlet field at uniform pitch. Each outlet shows a 3-dot pin-slot pattern and reads as a discrete aperture against the red body — not a painted stripe. Count is visually dense (~35-42 elements consistent with 42 at ~34 mm pitch). Recess depth is shallow — cavity floor barely reads darker than the housing face — acceptable at blockout tier.

default shot: two saturated strips — strongly saturated red and strongly saturated blue — side by side. Colors are unmistakably contrasting and correct for A/B feed identification. Not one lone strip, not two same-color strips. Strongest critical in this set.

head shot: distinct controller head occupies the top ~10-12% of each strip. Emissive LCD panel confirms ON/OFF state delta between default and head shots — bright white square when DISPLAY:ON, dark grey when OFF. Port row is present below the LCD as a flat rectangular band readable as RJ45/USB area. Small LED indicator square is visible below the port row. Head reads as a distinct module, not a plain cap. Individual jack cavities are not yet subdivided.

important_features.note: default shot: thick black cord exits the tail of each strip and routes away at an angle, confirming socket attachment at the tail end. Exit direction reads as a swivel departure toward the rack cable path. Cord geometry is clearly present and not floating.

mounts shot: BOTONES MONTAJE:SÍ toggle is highlighted, but no discernible geometry change from the default shot is visible in any pixel area of either strip. Camera azimuth ~34° from front does not expose the rear face. No button protrusions are readable on any strip edge across all four shots. Geometry may exist on the rear face but is unconfirmable from available pixel evidence — toggle has zero visual effect from this angle.

defects: rear-mount-buttons unconfirmed: BOTONES MONTAJE toggle has no visible geometric effect from the front-facing camera; no protrusions readable on any edge in any of the four captures
outlet cavity shallow: cavity floor barely darker than the housing face in feeda shot; 'visibly dark cavity' requirement approaches its floor at closer passes
head port row is flat: RJ45/USB area reads as a single flat rectangular band with no individual jack cavities; acceptable at blockout but close to the floor
corrections: Add a dedicated rear-face capture for BOTONES MONTAJE:SÍ — orbit camera to azimuth ~210° so mount buttons are actually framed, OR ensure button protrusions are >= 4 mm deep so they read around the side edge at the default 34° azimuth
Deepen outlet cavity mesh: push the cavity floor inward >= 4 mm in the instanced outlet so the dark center reads clearly at feeda zoom level
Subdivide head port row: split the flat port-row band into individual RJ45 + USB box meshes so each jack reads as a distinct recessed socket in the head zoom
